def_en: 1) to stand, take one's stand, stand upright, be set (over), establish
1a1) to station oneself, take one's stand
1a3) to stand, take an upright position
1c) (Hophal) to be fixed, be determined, be stationary
kjv: appointed, deputy, erect, establish, [idiom] Huzzah (by mistake for a proper name), lay, officer, pillar, present, rear up, set (over, up), settle, sharpen, establish, (make to) stand(-ing, still, up, upright), best state.
expl: to station, in various applications (literally or figuratively)
